svg.title: pi agent session activity through 11/12/26
svg.desc: Daily totals from all persisted pi sessions for this repository, including sub-agent workers and the walkthrough guide. The first chart compares user messages and agent tool calls; the second shows recorded model cost in US dollars, split by session type.
svg.text: Agent activity and cost by day
Sessions are dated by the day they started. Sub-agent cost is dated by its own start day. $0 days had little or no paid model usage.
Generated 11/12/26 from local pi session metadata only; prompt and tool contents are not included.
